title: Start WhatsApp bridge and restore channel connectivity
description: Bridge at WHATSAPP_BRIDGE_URL (localhost:3001) refuses connections; BRIDGE_PORT=3001 is configured in services/whatsapp-bridge/.env but no process is listening. Restore the bridge runtime so WhatsApp connections and live signals work.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (7): architect, backend, qa, release, infrastructure_bootstrap, infrastructure_guardian, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: Restore bridge runtime; port already aligned (3001), config valid
Bridge config verified (BRIDGE_PORT=3001, URL matches); runtime restore only
Will verify health endpoint and channel status after restart
Operational restore; will verify bridge health before reporting
Ensure bridge deps installed and service starts cleanly
Will record incident and restore steps in engineering memory
